issues.location: interpretation of function symbols in a structure
issues.finding: Saying that each function symbol is interpreted by a function from the domain to itself describes only unary symbols; the arity may be any natural number.
issues.proposed_resolution: Say each function symbol is assigned a function from the Cartesian power of the domain appropriate to its arity into the domain.

translation_treatment: The Javanese target states the arity-appropriate Cartesian-power interpretation. The bounded comparison view records the clarification; frozen English bytes remain unchanged.
